t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
st: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
d: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn seems to have a tolerance for the spores.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
st: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
d: While waiting for Moya to pick their Transport Pod, Zhaan tells Crichton of Moya's adventures after the Gammak base was destroyed.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
st: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
d: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast makes it through and causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
st: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
d: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
st: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
d: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
st: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
d: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
st: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
d: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
st: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
d: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
st: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
d: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
d: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
st: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
d: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
st: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
d: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
st: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
d: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
st: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
d: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo anxiously waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
st: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
d: The crew is going to break into the depository to free Crichton. Crichton is being tortured for wormhole technology.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
st: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
d: Wealthy from their bank heist, Moya's crew heads straight to meet with Diagnosan Tocot, a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
st: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
d: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, left with his head open on an operating table, while Scorpius attempts to avoid discovery.

t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
st: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
d: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of their money. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.
